integrity: Proof via exact killed Green function, renewal resolvent, and two-point Feynman-Kac; independently implemented finite-state Feynman-Kac numerical comparison is supplementary, not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Strictly for one-dimensional Brownian motion with generator D times second derivative, exponential resetting to R at rate r, two interior sites 0<a<b<=R, and occupation-density local-time convention; other reset locations, more sites, non-Markovian resetting, finite-width detectors and non-Brownian motions not covered. General Green/Kac formalism may make this specialization implicit in broader literature. No external scientific audit or experimental test.
title: Exact bivariate local-time synchronization before absorption
